subject: Can I fix a parameter to a value provided by a variable computed in R?

messages.author: d7a0adcea55a3874
messages.subject: Can I fix a parameter to a value provided by a variable computed in R?
parts:
Dear lavaan community,
I want to run a series of simulations with single-indicator models. This requires fixing the error term (or alternatively the loading) of each indicator to a value computed outside of lavaan, represented by a variable in R. Can I specify in the model syntax that a loading should be fixed to a value given by an R variable?
All the best
Klaus

messages.author: 061281a8cdc1f42e
messages.subject: Can I fix a parameter to a value provided by a variable computed in R?
parts:
In your model syntax, use a c("") instead of just notes and separate your model syntax from the call to the R variable:

Model = c("
f=~ item
Item~~*", Rvar, "item")
